description: This script analyzes TypeScript source files within a repository to verify that all openclaw/plugin-sdk/<subpath> module specifiers are properly exported in package.json and registered in plugin-sdk-entrypoints.json. It performs directory scanning, AST parsing to identify module specifiers, and reports violations where references are missing exports or entrypoints.

methods.name: readPackageExports
methods.description: Reads package.json exports and filters for plugin-sdk subpaths, returning a set of exported subpaths.

methods.name: readEntrypoints
methods.description: Reads plugin-sdk entrypoints JSON and filters out the 'index' entry, returning a set of entrypoints.

methods.name: parsePluginSdkSubpath
methods.description: Extracts subpath from module specifier strings starting with 'openclaw/plugin-sdk/', returns null if not matching.

methods.name: compareEntries
methods.description: Comparison function for sorting violation objects based on file, line, kind, specifier, and subpath.

methods.name: collectViolations
methods.description: Main logic to scan source files, parse module specifiers, and identify missing exports or entrypoints violations.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point that calls collectViolations and outputs the results, indicating success or listing violations.
